metadata.title: MaaEnd - Endfield Assistant
metadata.description: Advanced AI automation assistant for "Arknights: Endfield". Intelligent, Efficient, Cross-platform.

hero.title: MaaEnd
hero.tagline: "Arknights: Endfield" Automated Tool Powered by Visual AI
hero.downloadTipGitHub: MaaEnd is an open-source project. Downloads are hosted on GitHub (overseas servers). Speed depends on your network and is not related to the project itself. If downloads are slow or fail, try enabling a proxy and retrying.
hero.downloadTipMirror: MirrorChyan is an independent third-party download acceleration service, and is not affiliated with this project. If you already have a CDK, you can use it directly for accelerated downloads.
hero.androidBetaTip: The Android build is currently available as a beta only. It may be unstable — feedback is welcome.

realTimeTask.title: Real-time Assist
realTimeTask.detail: Early-game copilot upgraded! Focus fire, attacks/dodges/chains, and smart story branch/skip; auto handles guidance, manual pages, and voice cleanup. Plus loot, teleports, ziplines, puzzles, Aerial Salvage, and mounts for a buttery smooth run~ 🎮

combat.title: Combat Challenges
combat.detail: Protocol Space and essence farming spend sanity automatically, and can use limited-time potions when it runs out; Umbral Monument and War Echo clear uncleared stages with configurable retries; Trial of Swordmancy, Environment Monitoring, and Arena of Games are covered too! ⚔️

puzzleSolver.title: Puzzle Solver
puzzleSolver.detail: AI solves puzzles instantly — no more scratching your head! Supports single/loop/demo modes 😎

openWorld.title: Open World
openWorld.detail: Auto-gathers along field resource routes, harvests/plants/waters the Eco Farm, and collects from owl recycle stations; Aerial Salvage and tracked missions can run on their own. Plus zipline import and cleanup, team switching, and blueprint import for smoother building! 🧺

blueprints.title: Trading & Delivery
blueprints.detail: Stockpiling, staple-goods buying, and flexible-demand selling work together so you can watch margins and manage vouchers; outpost products are exchanged automatically, commissions get snatched, and accept-and-forward or full auto delivery are all on the table! 💸

essenceFilter.title: Essence & Growth
essenceFilter.detail: Recognizes essence attributes and locks/discards them by weapon rarity, essence type, and extra rules; also handles sanity extraction, weapon upgrades, gear crafting, and operator level-ups! 💎

dijiang.title: Dijiang Ship
dijiang.detail: Collects base outputs and restocks, runs clue collection/placement/gifting and exchanges; visits friends for production assistance and intel, gives operators gifts and collects returns, and sends or cleans up friend lists in bulk! 🚀

dailyRewards.title: Daily Automation
dailyRewards.detail: Claims mission/pass/mail/storage/event rewards, simulation rewards, wiki dots, and handbook rewards; plus Yuanyuan Manor innkeeping, credit shopping, Baker chats, Intel Archive, pull counting, and account switching — all in one click! ✅

crossPlatform.title: Cross Platform
crossPlatform.detail: Windows, Android, and Linux are fully supported, and Mac users can run it via PlayCover — enjoy the game on any platform! 🐟

about.title: AI VISUAL AUTOMATION
about.paragraph1: More than a script, MaaEnd is an AI-driven automation core. Built on MaaFramework’s black-box architecture, it uses a [Capture → Recognize → Decide → Execute] visual loop to provide human-like intelligence with a non-invasive, memory-safe approach.
about.paragraph2: From solving complex puzzles instantly and intelligently filtering essence stats to providing real-time early-game assistance, MaaEnd is dedicated to handing repetitive labor over to AI. Operating with high efficiency across both PC and mobile, it lets you leave tedious configuration behind and return to the pure joy of strategy and exploration.
